people.name: Goshen
people.line: A region in Egypt where the Israelites settled and prospered.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
translations.bsb: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.
